subject: Can I use one input as the value of an argument to sliderInput()?

messages.author: 53edadbd89a3ca9c
messages.subject: Can I use one input as the value of an argument to sliderInput()?
parts:
I am using fileInput() to allow a user to select a number of files. I would like to use the number of selected files as the value for the max argument of sliderInput(). I want to be able to show multiple plots of the data, one at a time, using a slider bar. Is this possible? Below is just a truncated & simplified bit of my ui.R code and put in some comments. Any help is greatly appreciated!

#ui.R
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
 sidebarPanel( 
   fileInput('files','Select files',  #use nrow(input$files) for sliderInput()??
    multiple = TRUE,
    accept = NULL)
),

 mainPanel(
  tabsetPanel(
   tabPanel('Plot',
            sliderInput("file", "File:", 
                        min=1, max= 10,   # I want max to be the number of files
                        value=1,  step=1,
                        format="",animate=TRUE),
            h5('Plot'),
            plotOutput('plot', height = '300px')
  )
 )
))

messages.author: 4be88a5fc86a040f
messages.subject: Re: Can I use one input as the value of an argument to sliderInput()?
parts: You can use renderUI() to change the change max/min of a slider based on number of files selected. See tutorial.
